title: Resolve tier-1 support requests without a human
text: A routine customer request (password reset, order status, how-do-I) is answered correctly and closed with no person handling it. L1 self-service ticket deflection AI first response cs

title: Flag customers likely to leave from their interactions
text: Accounts whose conversations, usage and tone point to churn are flagged early enough to act. churn prediction at-risk detection cs

title: Draft replies a support agent sends with light edits
text: A support agent receives a drafted reply grounded in the customer's history and the knowledge base and sends it with minor edits or none. reply suggestions agent assist cs

title: Score every support interaction against the quality rubric
text: Each interaction receives a quality score consistent with a trained reviewer's, so coaching needs no sampling. QA scoring conversation quality cs

title: Summarize a customer conversation for the next handler
text: A conversation of any length is condensed into what was asked, what was done and what is open, and the next handler needs nothing else. case summary wrap-up notes cs

title: Route incoming tickets to the right queue
text: Every new ticket lands in the queue and priority a trained agent would have chosen, before a person reads it. ticket triage auto-routing cs

title: Implement a scoped change from a written task
text: A task with clear scope becomes a mergeable change that passes tests and review with limited rework. coding agent autonomous coding eng

title: Investigate incidents to a root cause
text: An incident is investigated from logs, metrics and changes to a root cause a responder confirms. incident analysis RCA eng

title: Keep dependencies current and safe
text: Dependency updates are proposed, tested and merged, and known vulnerabilities are closed within the policy window. dependency management dependabot eng

title: Review pull requests for defects and risks
text: A pull request receives review comments that find real defects and risks a careful reviewer would, with few false alarms. AI code review PR review eng

title: Triage incoming issues and reproduce them
text: New issues are labeled, deduplicated and reproduced or marked unreproducible, with the steps recorded. issue triage bug triage eng

title: Write and maintain documentation from the code
text: Documentation is written from the code and kept current as it changes, and readers find what they need. docs generation eng

title: Write tests that cover a change or a module
text: Tests are added that fail on the defect and pass on the fix, and coverage of the changed code rises. test generation eng

title: Categorize expenses to the chart of accounts
text: Every expense lands in the account and cost center a controller would choose. expense coding GL coding fin

title: Draft the commentary explaining budget variances
text: Each material variance in the monthly pack carries a draft explanation grounded in the underlying transactions. management reporting flux analysis fin

title: Flag transactions that look wrong before they post
text: Duplicates, unusual amounts, odd counterparties and policy breaches are flagged before money moves. fraud detection anomaly detection fin

title: Forecast cash position over the coming weeks
text: A rolling cash forecast that a treasurer trusts for the next 13 weeks, updated as receivables and payables move. cash forecasting treasury forecast fin

title: Match supplier invoices to purchase orders and receipts
text: An incoming invoice is matched to its order and receipt lines, with exceptions surfaced, without manual keying. three-way match AP automation fin

title: Reconcile bank and ledger balances
text: Bank lines and ledger entries are matched and every unmatched item is explained or queued, by the close date. bank reconciliation close automation fin

title: Answer employees' policy and benefits questions
text: An employee's question about leave, benefits or policy is answered correctly from the handbook, or routed when it cannot be. HR helpdesk employee self-service hr

title: Draft a job description from a hiring brief
text: A hiring manager's brief becomes a posting that needs light edits and passes the compliance review. JD writing hr

title: Schedule interviews across candidates and panels
text: Interview slots are booked across candidate and panel calendars without back-and-forth. interview coordination hr

title: Screen applications against the role's requirements
text: Every application is scored against the stated requirements with reasons a recruiter can read and override. resume screening candidate ranking hr

title: Summarize engagement survey comments into themes
text: Free-text survey comments become themes with representative quotes and counts a leader can act on. survey analysis voice of employee hr

title: Answer questions from the company's internal knowledge
text: A question about how things work here is answered from the wiki and documents, with the source, or routed. internal search knowledge assistant it

title: Detect anomalous access to systems and data
text: Logins and data access that break a user's pattern are flagged for review before harm. UEBA insider threat detection it

title: Resolve routine IT requests without a technician
text: Password resets, access requests and how-do-I questions are resolved end to end with no technician. IT helpdesk automation IT self-service it

title: Triage monitoring alerts to the right responder
text: Alerts are deduplicated, grouped and routed to the right responder with the context to act. alert triage AIOps it

title: Answer compliance questions from the policy corpus
text: A question about what the rules allow is answered with the policy passage that says so, or routed. compliance helpdesk legal

title: Extract obligations and dates from signed contracts
text: Every obligation, deadline and renewal in a contract is extracted into the register with its clause. contract abstraction obligation management legal

title: Monitor regulatory changes that affect the business
text: Changes in the regulations the company is subject to are detected, summarized and mapped to the affected policies. regulatory intelligence horizon scanning legal

title: Review a non-disclosure agreement against the playbook
text: An incoming NDA is marked up against the company playbook, with deviations explained, before a lawyer looks. NDA review contract review legal

title: Run A/B tests on creative and pick winners
text: Variants of headlines, images or copy are tested on live traffic and the winner is chosen by a stated method. split testing creative testing mkt

title: Draft campaign copy in the brand's voice
text: Copy for a campaign brief arrives in the brand's voice and passes review with light edits. copywriting content generation mkt

title: Monitor and summarize mentions of the brand
text: Mentions across the web and social are collected, classified by sentiment and topic, and summarized daily. social listening brand monitoring mkt

title: Optimize email creative per recipient
text: Subject lines, images and links vary per recipient and the campaign converts better than the single version. email creative optimization email creative testing mkt

title: Optimize a landing page's conversion rate
text: Changes to a landing page are tested and the page converts better than before at a stated confidence. CRO landing page optimization mkt

title: Personalize email content per segment or recipient
text: Each recipient sees content chosen for them and the campaign outperforms the unpersonalized version. email personalization mkt

title: Publish and maintain a public web presence
text: Pages are written, published and kept current on a site the public reads, without a human in the publish path. content publishing site maintenance mkt

title: Classify spend into categories for analysis
text: Every transaction and line item is classified into the spend taxonomy consistently enough to negotiate on. spend analysis spend cube proc

title: Compare supplier quotes on a like-for-like basis
text: Quotes with different structures are normalized and compared, with the differences that matter called out. bid analysis quote comparison proc

title: Draft a request for proposal from requirements
text: A stakeholder's requirements become an RFP that suppliers can answer without clarification rounds. RFP writing proc

title: Monitor suppliers for risk signals
text: Financial, delivery, compliance and news signals about suppliers are watched and surfaced before they become incidents. supplier risk third-party risk proc

title: Draft personalized outreach messages
text: A first message to a prospect is drafted from what is known about them and sent with light edits. sales outreach sequence writing sales

title: Enrich leads with firmographic and contact data
text: Every new lead is completed with company size, industry, role and contact details from public sources. lead enrichment data enrichment sales

title: Score leads by likelihood to convert
text: Leads are ranked so that working the top of the list converts more than working in order of arrival. lead scoring sales

title: Summarize sales calls into notes and next steps
text: A recorded call becomes notes, objections and next steps a rep would have written. call summaries conversation intelligence sales

title: Update the CRM from calls and emails
text: Fields, stages and next steps in the CRM change to reflect what happened in conversations, without manual entry. CRM hygiene CRM automation sales

title: Forecast demand per item and location
text: A demand forecast at the item and location level that beats the naive baseline and the previous method. demand planning scm

title: Plan delivery routes that cut miles and keep windows
text: Daily routes meet delivery windows with fewer miles and vehicles than the previous plan. route optimization scm

title: Propose reorders that keep service levels within stock targets
text: Reorder proposals hold the service level while lowering stock, and a planner approves most without change. replenishment inventory optimization scm

title: Detect shipments that will miss their window
text: Delays are detected from carrier and telemetry data early enough to re-plan or warn the customer. shipment visibility exception management scm
